## "date_asset_updated_ars"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Timestamp of the type: ISO 8601:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
Timestamp for when an assets files have been changed. This is defined as when a change has been successfully synced with ERDA. Changes can be changes, deletions or additions of files.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
ARS when a sync with ERDA that changes the files belonging to an asset happens.  

**Updated where and when:**  
ARS when a sync with ERDA that changes the files belonging to an asset happens.

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
None

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
